top.title: Zealand Pharma announces initiation of the registrational Phase 3 ZUPREME program of petrelintide in people with overweight or obesity
top.summary: Zealand Pharma announced the initiation of its global Phase 3 ZUPREME program for petrelintide, a once-weekly injectable treatment for weight management. The program consists of three trials enrolling approximately 7,000 participants across different patient populations. The Phase 3 advancement is based on positive Phase 2 results showing double-digit weight loss with a tolerability profile comparable to placebo. The development is being conducted in partnership with Roche.

top.title: CHMP Backs CORT's Lifyorli Combo in Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer
top.summary: Corcept Therapeutics announced that the European Medicines Agency's CHMP committee issued a positive opinion recommending approval of Lifyorli (relacorilant) combined with nab-paclitaxel for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer treatment. The recommendation will be reviewed by the European Commission with a final decision expected in Q4 2026. Lifyorli generated $47.6 million in Q2 2026, its first quarter of commercial availability. The company is also studying relacorilant for other solid tumors and resubmitted an NDA for Cushing's syndrome treatment.

top.title: JOBY Makes History With Fully Autonomous Flight Across the United States
top.summary: Joby Aviation successfully completed a 3,199-mile autonomous flight across the United States with zero control inputs from an onboard pilot. The achievement showcases potential applications in commercial freight, medical transport, disaster response, and defense logistics.

top.title: NeOnc Charting New Nasal Route to Treating Brain Cancer
top.summary: NeOnc Technologies (NASDAQ: NTHI) reported Phase 2a results for NEO100, an intranasal formulation of perillyl alcohol for recurrent high-grade glioma. top.title: Body Contouring Devices Market Expands as Non-Invasive Technology Reaches Untapped Male Demographic
top.summary: The global body contouring devices market is expected to grow from $2.41 billion in 2025 to $8.82 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 13.84%. Non-invasive treatments dominate with 78.4% market share, driven by rising obesity rates and increasing demand for non-surgical aesthetic procedures. The U.S. market alone is projected to reach $2.74 billion by 2035. Key growth drivers include expanding male demographics, multi-modal technology platforms, and rising social media influence on aesthetic awareness.
